facts.text: Founded in 1961, the University of Mobile is affiliated with the Alabama Baptist State Convention and sits on a campus spanning over 880 acres.

sources.title: University of Mobile Cuts the Ribbon at Renovated J.L. Bedsole ...
sources.quote: The university was founded in 1961 and is affiliated with the Alabama Baptist State Convention. Located 10 miles north of Mobile, Alabama, on a campus of over 880 acres, UM offers associate, bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees
